features: 130 geometry/interaction values; learned continuous 48-dimensional projection, no player/team ID embedding

regularisation.layer_norm: projection and recurrent output per timestep
regularisation.initialisation: Xavier input/output, orthogonal recurrent gate blocks, LSTM input forget bias 1

training: AdamW lr .001; bounded-window BPTT; no cross-window state, no teacher forcing; unknown/context/padded labels excluded
inference: matching overlap-save windows, team-symmetric average, offline bidirectional context where configured
selection: highest validation clean/masked spell F1 > reference, with pooled misses, merge overlaps and false positives <= reference and historical short-pulse guard

inapplicable_methods.scheduled_sampling: no previous label is ever an input; no teacher-forcing exposure bias
inapplicable_methods.word_embeddings: continuous tracking features, not text tokens; use learned continuous projection
inapplicable_methods.language_RL: no language generation or diversity objective; use supervised labels and guarded spell decoding
